records.title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) Non-degree Exchange Program

validation.notes: GET verified 2026-10-05: HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, 3945 bytes, intrinsic 177x57 px. Visually inspected: the NIIED emblem (navy + crimson swoosh, blue 'NIIED' panel) plus the English wordmark 'National Institute for International Education' in dark ink on a transparent background. It is the logo of the record's own official_source, NIIED, a national institute operated under the Korean Ministry of Education, and the page's own footer alt text says so verbatim ('교육부 소속 책임운영기관 국립국제교육원'). Confidence is MEDIUM for two reasons only: (a) the mark is the awarding INSTITUTION's logo, not a GKS-programme-specific mark - no GKS-specific brand asset is published anywhere on the record's official page, and the GKS programme is named separately in the page text; (b) 177x57 is the only resolution NIIED publishes for this lockup (the site's own CSS sizes it at 215x56), so it is small for a catalogue card. Not a favicon: NIIED's favicon family is a different asset entirely. Two colourways of the identical lockup exist; logo_b.png (used here) is the dark-ink version referenced by the record page's own stylesheet and renders on light backgrounds. The white-ink sibling /design/theme/niied/images/common/logo_w.png (same 177x57, same artwork, footer with the descriptive alt) is an equally official alternative if a dark card is ever needed.

records.title: Wellcome Early-Career Award

validation.notes: not_found is a well-evidenced absence, not a gap in effort. Wellcome DOES have an official logo and DOES publish it - but only inside a ZIP archive. Its canonical brand page https://wellcome.org/research-funding/guidance/ending-a-grant/logo-usage (linked as 'Wellcome logo' from the official media page https://wellcome.org/about-us/media-queries) offers exactly one download: a link labelled 'Download our logo' pointing at /sites/default/files/wellcome-logos.zip. I downloaded that 15,193,126-byte archive from cms.wellcome.org (HTTP 200, application/zip) and enumerated it: it contains Wellcome_logo/_Wellcome_logo_Off_Black.png (59,743 B), _Wellcome_logo_Off_White.png, the same two as .eps, plus the 'Funded by Wellcome' lockups and an 11 MB usage PDF. Those individual files are NOT addressable over HTTP - six candidate direct paths under cms.wellcome.org and wellcome.org all return 404, and the archive itself is not an image. The Wellcome wordmark used in the header/footer of every page on wellcome.org (including this record's own page) is an INLINE element at all and whose probed logo paths 404. Every other logo-like FILE on the official domains is a rejected class. Therefore image_url stays null per section 7. Third-party copies exist (seeklogo.com, Wikimedia Commons 'Wellcome Trust logo.svg') but section 7 rejects third-party mirrors outright, and the Commons file is additionally the superseded pre-2016 Wellcome Trust brand.

source.raw_extract: Section 'Download the logos' reads verbatim: 'Download our logo' -> href="/sites/default/files/wellcome-logos.zip" title="wellcome-logos.zip", with the page text 'Download our logo [ZIP 534KB] in a JPG, GIF, PNG or EPS format.' Section 'How to get approval to use Wellcome's logo': 'Please email logo@wellcome.org'. The record's own page https://wellcome.org/grant-funding/schemes/early-career-awards (title 'Wellcome Early-Career Awards') renders its logo as inline markup only: <svg aria-labelledby="site-header-logo" class="c-site-header__logo tw-z-high tw-block tw-text-wdsNeutral-10" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMid" role="img" viewBox="0 0 80 80"><title id="site-header-logo">Wellcome home</title> - no src, no href, no file behind it. Archive fetched from the linked location resolves to https://cms.wellcome.org/sites/default/files/wellcome-logos.zip (HTTP 200, application/zip, 15193126 bytes); ZIP central directory lists 'Wellcome_logo_set/Wellcome_logo/_Wellcome_logo_Off_Black.png' (59743), '_Wellcome_logo_Off_White.png' (64038) and the two .eps siblings.

records.title: Becas Nacionales de Inclusión 2026 (A. Becas de Licenciatura para Jefas de Familia; B. Apoyos Complementarios para Personas Indígenas; C. Apoyos Complementarios para Personas con Discapacidad)

validation.notes: GET verified 2026-10-05: HTTP 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, 96937 bytes. The asset is declared by the record's own page twice over: (1) in its Yoast schema.org graph, as the Organization logo with an explicit caption, and (2) as the rendered WordPress custom site logo (elementor-widget-theme-site-logo) at intrinsic 803x96. SVG header inspected: viewBox='0 0 803.4 96.9' with fills #611232 (guinda), #161a1d and #a57f2c (gold) - the exact SECIHTI brand palette also used on the page (data-dce-background-color='#611232', data-dce-title-color='#FFFFFF'/advanced background #A57F2C). IMPORTANT FOR INTEGRATION, contrast with LG-018's UNCF finding: here the schema.org 'logo' field points at the real horizontal wordmark lockup, NOT at a favicon. The favicon on this site is a different file entirely (favicon_escudo_nacional_dorado.svg, the Mexican national coat of arms). Identity match is exact: the record's official_source is 'Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades y Tecnología (SECIHTI), Gobierno de México' and the logo caption reads 'SECIHTI'. There is no Becas Nacionales programme-specific mark, so the ministry's own official lockup is the correct award brand. Same asset will be written for record 689 (same provider, same host) - that duplicate is intentional.
